children: Black Hawk Acquisition executed a suite of financing agreements with Meteora to support its pending merger with Vesicor. The package includes a $200.0 million Standby Equity Purchase Agreement providing on-demand equity over 36 months (extendable), an OTC equity prepaid forward for up to 1,350,000 shares, a related Subscription Agreement for Additional Shares, a Non-Redemption backstop on up to 2,124,077 shares, and associated Registration Rights. The forward features a $10.00 initial reset price and a 36-month valuation timeline, while the SEPA prices ordinary advances at 97% of market and allows optional pre-paid advances via discounted notes. Collectively, these arrangements are designed to mitigate redemptions, enhance liquidity at closing, and furnish flexible growth capital post-combination.
Agreement 1: Black Hawk Sets Up Share Forward for Up to 1.35 Million Shares With Meteora
: Up to 36 months post-closing, subject to acceleration
: Provide structured capital and support redemptions for Vesicor merger
Agreement 2: Black Hawk Secures Non-Redemption Backstop on Up to 2.12 Million Shares
: Through closing, subject to specified termination events
: Mitigate redemptions and stabilize trust cash at closing
Agreement 3: Black Hawk Signs Subscription for Additional Shares Tied to Forward Purchase
: Through and after closing per forward purchase terms
: Ensure forward share capacity and deal funding flexibility
Agreement 4: Black Hawk Establishes $200 Million Standby Equity Facility With Meteora
: Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (SEPA) up to $200 million
Agreement 5: Black Hawk Agrees to Resale Registration to Support SEPA and Note Conversions
: Registration Rights Agreement for SEPA and convertible notes
: Until resale registration is effective and maintained
: Enable Meteora’s resale of shares issued under SEPA
